special: Curated sequence of stress/breakdown pop-culture meme images and movie stills
audit.notes: The opening 3-second setup can easily be recreated with standard lifestyle b-roll (such as someone hastily packing a bag or looking stressed working at a desk), but the entire punchline relies on sourcing 10+ specific internet reaction memes and movie clips.
audit.summary: A woman acts out a stressed reaction to being praised for handling stress well, followed by a fast-paced slideshow of chaotic, breakdown-themed pop culture memes representing eldest daughters.
